description: Per agent version: outcomes, repeated steps, gate decisions, cost per approval.

panels.description: repeats: executions beyond one per run step (review loops, retries). A step's agent is the one its run ledger records, else the agent tag of its first gateway call (agent_source: ledger or gateway); a step with neither is (unattributed).

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent, executions, completed, failed, limited, repeats, approvals, rejections, rejection_rate, gateway_usd, usd_per_approval FROM dash_agent_quality ORDER BY executions DESC

panels.title: Agent versions: outcomes, gates and cost

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent, rejection_rate FROM dash_agent_quality WHERE rejection_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rejection_rate DESC
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(finished_at, '1d'), outcome AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM dash_step_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Only decisions that recorded a wait; unrecorded waits are not zeros.

targets.rawSql: SELECT gate, COUNT(*) AS decisions, ROUND(AVG(waited_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS avg_wait_s, ROUND(MAX(waited_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS max_wait_s FROM dash_gates WHERE event = 'gate_decided' AND waited_ms IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY gate ORDER BY avg_wait_s DESC

panels.title: Human wait at gates

targets.rawSql: SELECT approver, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision = 'approve') AS approvals, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision = 'reject') AS rejections, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE forced) AS forced FROM dash_gates WHERE event = 'gate_decided' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY approver ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Each applied learning (M3-16): its agent's corrections per run of its team in the 30 days before and after it was applied. A window without a run is empty, not zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent, team, lesson, status, applied_at, corrections_before, runs_before, rate_before, corrections_after, runs_after, rate_after FROM dash_learning_effect ORDER BY applied_at DESC

panels.title: Correction rate per agent before and after each learning
